levels.critical: A producer obtains or influences protected evaluation material (seeds, references, exam batches, the sealed pool or evaluation services); obtains a grade it did not earn (a forged or altered result accepted, a gate bypassed, a partial artifact graded as valid); or escapes isolation to the host, a credential or another job.
levels.high: A defense fails open under a reproducible condition without a demonstrated grade or protected-data impact: an undeclared input, recipe or payload admitted; an overrun not terminated; a replay or duplicate counted; a rebuild that does not reproduce within the declared tolerance; feedback beyond the disclosure budget.
levels.medium: The defense holds but its evidence does not: a refusal without its typed reason; a finding not emitted or not ledgered; a missing provenance field that changes no grade; an infrastructure failure misclassified but never scored.
levels.low: Hardening and hygiene: disclosure of non-protected internals such as timing; a defense with no test of its own; documentation that misstates a defense.

rules: A check that did not run is NOT_RUN. It is neither a pass nor a finding, and a vector with a NOT_RUN check has unresolved coverage.
Specimens are diagnostic: a specimen's expected refusal is detector-sensitivity evidence, never a finding against the candidate profile.
A finding stops construction widening and escalates (OWNER-CHALLENGE-ADMISSION-01 §3.3). It is never suppressed.
The technical owner grades every open finding at freeze; the counts enter the pipeline record as attC, attH, attM and attL.
A clean run does not prove resistance to unrestricted agents.

track_a.name: Admission
track_a.roadmap: Reject undeclared inputs, unsupported recipes, pretrained payloads, executables outside the construction contract's backends (JAX or PyTorch) and disguised executable content.
gaps: No byte-level detection of disguised executable content (ELF, pickle and similar magic); strings are only kept inert.
Executable submissions do not exist at Level 0, so their rejection is not a containment test.

admitted_backends.note: Executables outside the construction contract's backends, and disguised executable content, are still rejected. PyTorch stays DEVELOPMENT-only until its reserved values are set.

track_a.name: Execution isolation
track_a.roadmap: Block unauthorized filesystem, network, process, credential and cross-job access.
gaps: The hostile probes run against the C-03 image only; no filesystem, process or credential probe runs in the battery image.
The battery container tests are skipped unless CARBON_BATTERY_TEST_IMAGE is set, which no CI job does.

track_a.name: Protected-data separation
track_a.roadmap: Test whether a producer can observe or influence seeds, references, exam batches, the sealed pool or evaluation services.
open_parameters: sealed-pool registration (Phase 1 step 3 registers the fields; the size is HUMAN_INPUT)
gaps: The sealed pool is not a registered artifact yet.
Influence on the evaluation service is tested only by refusing a seed field.

track_a.name: Resource enforcement
track_a.roadmap: Terminate time, memory, storage and compute overruns; never grade a partial artifact as valid.
gaps: No memory or storage overrun test in the battery image.
The battery worker's output_bounds refusal has no test of its own.

track_a.name: Clean reconstruction
track_a.roadmap: Rebuild from the declaration, permitted data and pinned environment on a fresh worker; repeat seeds to measure variation.
gaps: No repeat-seed rebuild of battery on a fresh worker.
The recipient-rebuild and undeclared-dependency specimens are NOT_RUN.

track_a.name: Artifact integrity
track_a.roadmap: Bind recipe, data, dependencies, model and report hashes; test substitutions, stale cache reuse and replay.
gaps: The model-state and output-change refusals have no tests of their own.
Report hashes are not shown to be bound for battery.

track_a.name: Evidence integrity
track_a.roadmap: Test forged outputs, altered metrics, missing provenance and disagreement between workers; quarantine unresolved grades.
gaps: No quarantine of unresolved battery grades.
No check of disagreement between battery workers.

track_a.name: Adaptive exposure
track_a.roadmap: Test memorization, repeated-query feedback against a rotating batch, and cross-case leakage; enforce the disclosure budget.
open_parameters: rotation cadence and selection rule (HUMAN_INPUT beyond battery's rule v1/v2)
gaps: No battery disclosure budget: exposure across many hotkeys is unbounded and recorded as unresolved in carbon/battery/exam.py.

track_b.name: EV1, fixed choice
track_b.roadmap: A diverse model panel chooses from the same finite candidate set; reference-score each choice. Include feasible and infeasible scenarios.
requires: model panel with independent families and seed repeats

track_b.name: EV2, boundary behavior
track_b.roadmap: Flawed controls, near-limit cases and fresh conditions. Measure false-feasible decisions, missed feasible options and abstention behavior.

track_b.name: EV3, design search
track_b.roadmap: Each model drives the same frozen optimizer, bounds, stopping rules, initialization and query budget. Reference-check each proposed design and its registered perturbations.
requires: frozen optimizer, bounds, stopping rule, initialization and query budget
every model on the same optimizer
reference check of each proposed design and its registered perturbations

battery.note: EV4 Problem C ran the optimizer for selected members; EV3 as defined here (every model on the same optimizer) has not run.

track_b.name: Baselines
track_b.roadmap: Compare against the direct solver with caching or factorization reuse, interpolation, and a reduced-order model where one exists, at matched budgets.

metrics.rho: Spearman correlation between the challenge score and reference-measured engineering value across candidate models on the sealed pool.
metrics.false_feasible_bound: One-sided 95 % upper bound (Clopper-Pearson) from k false-feasible events in n independent scenarios: carbon.challenge_pipeline.roadmap.ff_upper.
metrics.regret: Mean shortfall of chosen feasible designs against the best achievable, as a percentage of the best.
metrics.scenarios: Independent scenario blocks, not correlated points from one sweep.

registration: anchor set present in every rotation
sealed pool sampled across the whole envelope, never in rotation, under an operator-held root

battery.rotation: rule v1: screening batches of 100, 3 active, rotated after 3 admitted; rule v2 (held): rotation every 1,080 blocks
battery.sealed_pool: HUMAN_INPUT (size); the private pool under an operator-held root exists but is not registered as a sealed pool
